## Design

### 2026-10-12 – I started the design on the case, I made sure it would fit the pcb inside of it, I designed in an acrylic face so that the light can shine through, I made sure that there was room for the lights to be

**3h**

I started the design on the case, I made sure it would fit the pcb inside of it, I designed in an acrylic face so that the light can shine through, I made sure that there was room for the lights to be spaced away from the acrylic to naturally diffuse the light as opposed to having sharp dots, I then added a stand to make the clock stand up, and I added numbers around the face so that you can read it.
